name: warning: continuation rebuilt from last saved work
old:
Commit first. A continued agent keeps the copy it had: to show it new commits, start a
> fresh one.
new:
Commit first. A continued agent rebuilds its copy from its last saved work, not from your new
> commits: for those, start a fresh one.

name: §5 kept on turn or saving failure
old: and kept for you to look at when the turn fails.
new: and kept for you to look at when the turn or the saving fails.

name: §6 data-dir bullet restructured
old:
- **`~/.claude/plugins/data/codex-delegate-nowely`** — answers, run records, reports, write locks, a Codex
  home of the plugin's own, so your own Codex plugins, skills and memories cannot steer a turn, and the
  scratch of agents started from a shell that names no temp directory.
new:
- **`~/.claude/plugins/data/codex-delegate-nowely`** — answers, run records, reports, write locks, the
  worktree ledger, images you attached, the scratch of read-only agents started from a shell that names no
  temp directory, and a Codex home of the plugin's own, so your own Codex plugins, skills and memories
  cannot steer a turn.

name: §6 worktrees bullet: lifecycle and refs
old:
- **`.claude/worktrees` inside your repository** — the throwaway copies, while a turn runs and after one
  fails.
new:
- **`.claude/worktrees` inside your repository** — the throwaway copies while a turn runs, and a failed
  turn's copy until you remove it or a later run finds it clean; a crashed run's commits are kept under
  `refs/codex-delegate/`.

name: §6 closing: pruning, no cleanup promise, locks
old:
Answers, run records and that scratch age out by count and by age. Reports, the private home and a failed
turn's copy stay until you remove them; `/codex-delegate:cleanup` lists what the plugin left. A write lock
lasts as long as its run.
new:
Answers, run records and that scratch age out by count and by age; reports and the private home stay until
you remove them. A write lock goes when its run ends, and one a killed run left behind is reclaimed by the
next.

name: §9 the sourced claim, made precise
old:
driving `codex app-server`, the Codex interface that
reports back both the rights it applied and what each command did.
new:
driving `codex app-server`, the only Codex interface with
both per-call rights — sandbox and approval policy — and a machine-checkable record of what ran.

name: row 2: three causes that reach the report, lock cure
old: | the run is refused before it starts | the report's `error` says why: a full Codex quota window, a held write lock, a report path already used, no state directory | read it; for quota, wait or use a Claude subagent |
new: | the run is refused before it starts | the report's `error` says why: a full Codex quota window, a held write lock, no state directory | for quota, wait or use a Claude subagent; for a lock, wait for the run that holds it or give each run its own directory |

name: row 3: the OOM symptom, no cut
old: | a run dies mid-way in a large fan-out | out of memory — runs are killed, not queued — or the idle cut, which the report names and offers to resume | ask for fewer at once; a cut run continues from where it stopped |
new: | a run dies mid-way in a large fan-out, leaving no report | out of memory — runs are killed, not queued | ask for fewer at once |
